commodity_bar_meaning.explanation: This chart illustrates the composition of Cambodia's agricultural export value across major Harmonized System commodity chapters.
commodity_bar_meaning.key_takeaway: Cashew Nuts (HS 0801) dominates agricultural exports at $632.71 million USD (74.3% share), followed by Fresh & Dried Mangoes (HS 0804) at $187.62 million USD (22.1% share).
commodity_bar_meaning.action: Implement targeted sector support to increase secondary processing and domestic value addition for top-tier commodity crops like cashews and mangoes.

country_donut_meaning.explanation: This chart displays the destination market distribution and structural concentration risk of Cambodia's agricultural trade.
country_donut_meaning.key_takeaway: The market exhibits severe structural concentration risk with an HHI of 7,411, as Vietnam absorbs $722.70 million USD (85.1% share) and Thailand captures $106.18 million USD (12.5% share).
country_donut_meaning.action: Accelerate strategic trade negotiations and sanitary and phytosanitary protocol agreements to expand direct direct-to-consumer exports into China, the EU, and North America.

price_jump_meaning.explanation: This chart measures unit price differentials and value-addition multipliers between raw agricultural goods and processed alternatives.
price_jump_meaning.key_takeaway: Domestic processing yields a 5.0x price multiplier for Cashew Nuts (HS 0801) ($1.23/kg to $6.12/kg) and a 2.4x multiplier for Pepper & Capsicum (HS 0904) ($4.10/kg to $9.85/kg).
price_jump_meaning.action: Enact agro-processing tax holidays, energy tariffs relief, and concessional financing for factories investing in domestic shelling, grinding, and packaging infrastructure.

seasonality_line_meaning.explanation: This chart tracks monthly export volume and value fluctuations across harvest cycles throughout the calendar year.
seasonality_line_meaning.key_takeaway: Export volumes peak sharply during the Q1 harvest window from February to April before tightening significantly in Q3 and Q4.
seasonality_line_meaning.action: Construct strategically located cold-storage facilities and specialized bonded warehouses to buffer harvest gluts and stabilize year-round supply prices.

executive_strategy: Strategic priority 1 (Value-added processing): Transition away from raw export dependence by capitalizing on value multipliers (5.0x for Cashew Nuts and 2.4x for Pepper) through incentives for domestic processing investments.

Strategic priority 2 (Destination diversification): Mitigate critical market exposure (HHI 7,411; 85.1% dependence on Vietnam) by establishing direct trade routes, accredited testing laboratories, and SPS compliance for direct buyer markets.

Strategic priority 3 (Post-harvest logistics & cold-chain): Resolve Q1 seasonal supply gluts and price drops by building national cold-chain storage infrastructure and modern drying centers near key production zones.
